data.name: Jarirah
data.gender_notes: Jarirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'jarara' meaning 'to continue', 'to persist'. This name symbolizes a woman who is unwavering and constant in her love, dedication, and commitments. The name Jarirah carries the meaning “Continuous, uninterrupted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jarirah usually hope their child will grow to embody continuous, uninterrupted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Jarirah is a reflection of the spiritual qualities of nurturing, caring, and cultivating. It is a reminder of the importance of tending to our own spiritual gardens, ensuring that our inner selves flourish and grow. It is also a reminder of the beauty and peace that can be found in a well-tended spiritual life.
data.etymology: Jarirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Continuous, uninterrupted.”

It reminds us of the importance of remaining steadfast in our faith, even in the face of adversity and hardships. Just as the name symbolizes the persistence and commitment of a loving spouse to her husband, so too does it reflect the unwavering commitment of a servant of Allah to their Lord. The name Jarirah is a reminder that, just as love and dedication are essential in our human relationships, they are also a fundamental aspect of our spiritual journey towards Allah.
